general.q: What is iCET’s Software Engineering Program?
general.a:
iCET’s Software Engineering Program is a hands-on, industry-focused training course designed
to prepare students for real-world software development careers. It covers programming,
databases, web and mobile development, software design, and more.

Anyone with a passion for IT and technology can apply. But it depends on the selected program.
Contact our admin team (Hotline: 0705 805 805) for more details. Ideal candidates are:
● Students who have completed A/Ls (any stream)
● Students who have completed O/Ls
● Undergraduates
● Degree holders
● Professionals from any field
● Anyone interested in starting a career in Software Engineering

general.q: Do I need prior programming knowledge?
general.a:
No prior experience is required for our programs. We start from the basics and guide you toward
advanced Enterprise Level step by step.

The standard duration is 8–24 months, depending on the selected program. Contact our admin
team (Hotline: 0705 805 805) for more details.

general.q: What will I learn during the program?
general.a:
You will gain knowledge and skills in:
● Programming (Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.)
● Web Development (HTML, CSS, React, Node, Spring Boot)
● Database Management (MySQL, MongoDB)
● Software Engineering principles
● Version Control (Git/GitHub)
● Industry-focused project-based learning & real-world simulations
● Much more content included
Yes, upon successful completion of the program, students will receive a Certificate.

Yes. The iCET institute and programs are registered under the Tertiary & Vocational Education
Commission (TVEC). Reg. No: P03/0177

general.q: Is there any job placement support?
general.a:
We provide:
● Interview preparation & mock interviews
● Career guidance
● Industry placement
● Industry networking events

general.q: How much does the program cost?
general.a:
Course fees vary based on the program selected, ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 400,000. We
offer flexible payment plans to make it affordable for everyone. Contact our admin team (Hotline:
0705 805 805) for more details.

We are based in Panadure (12500), Sri Lanka and operate through both in-person training
centers and online learning platforms for remote learners.

Yes. We offer online, physical and hybrid classes. Students can join from anywhere in Sri
Lanka or abroad.

You can:
● Visit our website and fill out the online registration form
● Call/WhatsApp our support team (Hotline: 0705 805 805)
● Visit our office for walk-in registration

Our instructors are industry professionals with experience in Software Engineering. The lead
trainer, Dr. Niroth Samarawickrama, has over 20 years of experience preparing students for
entry into the field of software engineering.

general.q: Can university students join this as an extra qualification?
general.a:
Yes, many university students join to gain practical skills and industry exposure alongside their
academic degrees.

● Real-world project-based learning

There is no strict age limit. Skill and dedication are the most important factors. While age may
be considered during interviews, it is not a concern for freelancing or skill-based career paths.

general.q: Are These Programs Suitable for a Career Change?
general.a:
Yes. Our programs are designed to support learners from entry level to industry readiness,
making them ideal for career changers.

Payments can be made via:
● Online bank transfer

icd.q: Is there a software engineer course after A/L in Sri Lanka?
icd.a: Yes. iCD is iCET's one-year software engineer course after A/L, open to A/L leavers, O/L leavers, non-IT graduates, and career switchers. No prior programming experience is required to start.

icd.q: Do I need to go to university to become a software engineer?
icd.a: Not necessarily. iCD is a direct, practical alternative to a traditional degree path — four progressive levels plus 6 months of real industrial training, so you graduate with genuine project experience.

icd.q: What will I actually learn in iCD?
icd.a: Across four levels: programming fundamentals and databases, object-oriented development and web technologies, advanced API and enterprise development with Spring and Angular, and finally mobile, cloud, and agentic AI development using tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and n8n.

icd.q: How much does the iCD program cost?
icd.a: The full-time diploma is LKR 225,000, and the part-time diploma is LKR 200,000. Both offer an Early Bird one-time payment, a 20% discount one-time option, or a 3-part installment plan.

icd.q: Is iCD available online or in person?
icd.a: Both. iCD is available online, physically at iCET's Panadura campus, or in a hybrid format, supported by advanced virtual platforms and fully equipped labs.

icd.q: How do I apply after receiving my A/L results?
icd.a: Contact your student counsellor, request your offer letter, choose a payment plan, and submit your signed offer letter with payment receipt to complete registration.

icm.q: Is iCM a software development course for university students in Sri Lanka?
icm.a: Yes. iCM is iCET's 6-month software development course for university students in Sri Lanka who want practical, industry-ready skills alongside their degree. It is also open to A/L students, career switchers, and job seekers.

icm.q: How long is the iCM program?
icm.a: The iCM (iCET Certified Master) program is a 6-month, hands-on software development course delivered across three progressive levels.

icm.q: How much does the iCM course cost?
icm.a: The total course fee is LKR 125,000. A one-time payment option brings this down to LKR 90,000 with the current special offer, or you can choose a 2- or 3-installment payment plan.

icm.q: Can university students join iCM alongside their degree?
icm.a: Yes. iCM is specifically designed so currently enrolled university students can build practical software development skills alongside their degree, through flexible online, physical, or hybrid classes.

icm.q: Is iCM delivered online or in person?
icm.a: Both. iCM is available online, physically at iCET's Panadura campus, or in a hybrid format, so university students and other learners can choose what fits their schedule.

icm.q: What technologies will I learn in iCM?
icm.a: Across the three levels, students work with Java, MySQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Figma, Spring Boot, Angular, Git, GitHub, and IntelliJ IDEA, alongside core computer science topics like data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.

Contact your student counsellor (hotline 0705 805 805), request your offer letter, choose a payment option and complete payment, then submit your payment receipt with the signed offer letter to complete registration.
